original_statement:
What must hold? State the invariant or expectation this concerns. A finalized channel's SHIELD-allocation payout is one more output of N1b's single transactOwned spend on the pool, not a separate pool.shield call against a raw ERC-20 balance. The pool records a preimage for every payout note, so every payout is provable later. A SHIELD allocation to a plain recipient pays a note of the allocated amount. Zero-amount allocations are skipped. The ETH or raw-asset _transferAsset path stays unchanged.
What holds now? Describe the current, observed state. The adjudicator routes a SHIELD payout through _executeSingleAssetExit, which calls pool.shield against a raw ERC-20 balance. N1a removed that balance; holdings is now a bytes32 commitment, so the old pool.shield path cannot stand.
How do you see it? Describe exactly how to observe this for yourself — the steps to reproduce, or how you would demo it. Run forge test --match-contract ArmadaNitroAdjudicatorTest. One test funds a finalized channel and calls transfer with one SHIELD allocation to a plain recipient, then checks pool.preimageOf on the resulting commitment shows a note of the allocated amount. The command grep -n pool.shield src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol returns nothing. The full forge test suite compiles and passes.
What constraints apply? State them in plain prose. There is no protocol fee on a payout (operator ruling 2026-10-22): a payout is a plain output with no fee tag and no cumulativeFees coupling. Do not change the ETH or raw-asset _transferAsset path. This chunk adds no new pool view; transactOwned and preimageOf are already on IArmadaPool after N1b and N2a.
Where does this apply? (e.g. gateway route, mobile screen, CLI verb) src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol, the SHIELD branch of the transfer and payout path (_executeSingleAssetExit)
restatement: When a finalized channel pays out a SHIELD allocation, the adjudicator must pay it as one more output of the single transactOwned spend on the pool. It must not make a separate pool.shield call against a raw ERC-20 balance. The old path cannot work because holdings is now a bytes32 commitment. The pool records a preimage for every payout note, so each payout can be proved later. A SHIELD allocation to a plain recipient pays a note of the allocated amount. Zero-amount allocations are skipped. A payout carries no protocol fee. The ETH and raw-asset _transferAsset path stays unchanged. The whole forge suite compiles and passes.

restatement_clauses.text: A SHIELD payout is one more output of N1b's single transactOwned spend on the pool. It is not a separate pool.shield call. The command grep -n pool.shield src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol returns nothing.
A SHIELD allocation to a plain recipient on a finalized channel pays a note of the allocated amount. pool.preimageOf on the resulting commitment shows that note, so every payout is provable.
The ETH or raw-asset _transferAsset path stays unchanged.
A payout has no protocol fee. It is a plain output with no fee tag and no cumulativeFees coupling.
The full forge test suite compiles and passes, including forge test --match-contract ArmadaNitroAdjudicatorTest.

goal: Route SHIELD payouts in src/ArmadaNitroAdjudicator.sol through the single transactOwned spend so each payout has a provable preimage.
acceptance_criteria: With a pool that rejects any direct shield call, a finalized channel with one SHIELD allocation still pays out. The pool sees exactly one transactOwned spend that holds the payout.
A test funds a finalized channel and calls transfer with one SHIELD allocation to a plain recipient. The note recorded for the resulting commitment has the allocated amount.
A finalized channel has one zero-amount SHIELD allocation and one non-zero SHIELD allocation. Only the non-zero allocation produces a payout note.
A finalized channel pays an ETH allocation and a raw-asset allocation. Each recipient receives the exact amount through the old transfer path, and no pool note is created.
A SHIELD payout of a known amount creates a note of exactly that amount. The fee total on the pool does not change.
The adjudicator test contract ArmadaNitroAdjudicatorTest compiles and every test in it passes.
